period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported) as at 2021-06-30. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE FROM 1 JANUARY 2021 (as published in the FY2021 annual report's own 'Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials by the Audit Committee and by the Board' table), NOT discrete-quarter figures -- flagged via the _cumulative suffix; discrete-quarter figures were not computed by subtraction, per project convention (same as CITYBANK). Table title itself does not say 'Consolidated' or 'Solo' ('Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials by the Audit Committee and by the Board'), but its own Dec-31-2021 column reproduces total_assets (306,500.93), gross_loans (226,011.57), total_deposits (211,782.43), total_liabilities (286,846.02) and total_equity (19,654.77) matching the already-confirmed-CONSOLIDATED 2021_Q4.json to within normal rounding, confirming this table is Consolidated basis too -- same basis as the rest of MTB's series, no mismatch. DISCREPANCY FOUND vs the already-stored 2021_Q4.json (sourced from mtb-annual-report-2023.txt (retrospective comparative)): tax_expense (table 565.57 vs stored 566, +0.08%). This session's source is mtb-annual-report-2021.txt's OWN contemporaneous 'Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials' table for FY2021 -- i.e. more contemporaneous than the currently-stored Q4 figure for the fields listed. Per this task's explicit scope limits, 2021_Q4.json is left UNMODIFIED; this divergence is recorded here and in sources.json for a future session to reconcile (see project standing rule preferring contemporaneous over later-restated figures -- the fields above are exactly the kind of case that rule is meant to catch). Other fields (total_assets, total_liabilities, total_equity, profit_after_tax) match closely (<0.08% drift, ordinary rounding). Balance-sheet identity (Total Property and Assets = Total Liabilities + Total Capital & Shareholders' Equity + Non-Controlling Interest) validated exactly (max drift BDT 0.01m, pure decimal-rounding noise) for all four quarters of 2021, including this Q2. Non-Controlling Interest (~BDT 0.13-0.14m) is omitted as its own line item here (rounds to 0 in whole millions) but is included in the identity check above. Cumulative Total Operating Income, Net Profit After Tax and Interest Income all increase monotonically Q1->Q2->Q3 for 2021 (Q1=2,721.94, Q2=5,626.30, Q3=8,670.98 for operating income; Q1=601.78, Q2=873.93, Q3=974.47 for net profit after tax) -- no violation.
